description.text: LENDER-APPROVED SHORT SALE! OVER $31,000 IN RECENT UPGRADES. THIS PROPERTY WAS OFFERED FOR $625,000 JUST 4 YEARS AGO AND SOLD FOR CLOSE TO THAT. Pool + sunroom + charm in the heart of Austin - this one checks all the boxes. Warm and inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offering 1,556 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Bright, open living areas create effortless flow for everyday living and easy entertaining, with natural light enhancing the welcoming feel throughout. The spacious living room connects seamlessly to the kitchen, while a standout light-filled sunroom offers the perfect flex space for a home office, creative studio, workout room, or relaxed morning coffee retreat overlooking the backyard. Step outside to your private oasis featuring a sparkling pool - ideal for cooling off during long Austin summers, hosting weekend gatherings, or unwinding after a busy day. The backyard provides space to lounge, dine, and enjoy indoor-outdoor living year-round. Three comfortable bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, remote work, or growing households.
